g.text: Sequence Diagram - AA02 Cancelled or Failed Google Sign-In
Precondition: phase 1 of SD 1 was completed:
a pending { state, nonce, codeVerifier } exists in the store,
the SPA saved "oidc_state" and the browser is at Google.
This diagram shows failure branches only; each one ends
the interaction without issuing a LaPrizza token.
[1) User cancels or denies consent at Google]
no call to the back end
You have not been signed in."
[2) Returned state does not match the state stored in this browser]
no call to the back end
[State matches: send code to the back end]
[3) Invalid payload (missing / oversized code or state, unknown fields)]
[4) Unknown, expired or already used state (replay)]
[5) Code rejected by Google or Google unreachable]
iss, aud, exp, nonce; check email_verified
[6) ID token invalid (signature, iss, aud, exp or nonce)]
[7) email_verified is false or e-mail missing]
In every branch no AuthTokenDTO is issued, so no protected functionality becomes available (AC 6).
The same uniform 401 message is used for all back-end authentication failures (4 to 7);
the specific reason is kept only in server logs.
